title: World Bloom — To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage — Episode6 Unpacking

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage
meta.Event Outline: On MORE MORE JUMP!'s first free day in quite some time, they have been enjoying school life to the full. Their recent TV appearance has caused a buzz among their classmates, renewing their determination to keep working their hardest. That's when they each find themselves in an unfamiliar part of SEKAI...!

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link_idol_op3
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Exhale*
Next is this room, yes?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Everything for the living room's all unpacked, but a lot of the boxes for the other rooms still haven't been opened.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right, and we have all of our streaming equipment to think about... It may take us quite a bit of time to get fully organized around here.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Still... This is pretty fun.
We're really getting to set up our home base like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it is! I know we're not moving in per se since we don't plan on living here or anything...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, this is the start of a new chapter for us. We're still just unpacking what we need at the moment, but I'm very excited.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Also, we couldn't have gotten this place at a better time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'll give you more details tomorrow, but the offers have been flowing in since Mr. Arimura's show aired...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: So, if we hadn't found this place when we did, we probably wouldn't have had any time to go house hunting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Really...?!
We've been receiving that many offers?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: In terms of brand-new ones, I'd say about double what we'd been receiving until now.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And on top of group offers, each of you has been receiving your own appearance offers!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Our own offers...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see...
I suppose it's only natural for more of those to be coming in...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, there's nothing wrong.
It's just a small thought.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I feel like we've been doing less and less streams together after we started receiving more offers to appear on our own...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Quite a few people have also been commenting on that lately. They'd ask where Haruka is when she's off somewhere else, or saying how they were hoping to see Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why I'm sort of worried that we're going to disappoint everyone if those kinds of things continue to happen.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I also understand that we need to keep receiving more work in order to increase our name recognition. It's become such a difficult puzzle...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, it is common for gaps to form between a group and their oldest fans as their fame increases...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I wouldn't worry about that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, why not...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Because everyone in MORE MORE JUMP! is really amazing. You, in particular, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Someone's calling. Is it your phone that's ringing, Saito...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh, it might be Airi calling back about the offer she received earlier. Sorry, I need to take this!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I wonder what she was going to say just now...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Still, it seems like Saito has already fully settled in as our manager.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And she hasn't actually been with us that long yet. It's truly remarkable how much we can count on her.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I mean, even when it came to finding a place to call the MORE MORE HOUSE, she found a good real estate agency while far away at home.)

rows.Speaker: Saito's Voice
rows.Line: Wait, right now?!

rows.Speaker: Saito's Voice
rows.Line:
No, um... That's okay.
I agree that we should discuss this in person, so... Yes, okay. I'll see you in a little bit. Bye.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Uhh... Sorry, Shizuku, but I...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
It isn't all that serious.
But I'm going to need to step out for a bit to deal with something regarding this one offer Airi received.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Please, don't mind me.
After all, our original plan for today was to chat, have some tea and maybe unpack a few boxes together.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm really sorry! It was an absolute honor to unpack boxes with you today, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I promise to make time again another day!
So, I hope you'll be willing to have me then!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be looking forward to it. Also...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for always doing your best for us. Please stay safe out there.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Sh-Shizuku's idol smile!
I couldn't have asked for a better send-off...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
This is better than any energy drink!
Wish me luck! I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, good luck!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. She's so funny when she gets all excited like that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's still too early to go home, so I think I'll do a little more unpacking before I do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi said that I didn't have to worry about any of the equipment, so I'll try sorting out our home décor and...
<Oh, perfect! Shizuku's here!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Rin? Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You two sound very excited about something. May I ask what?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <There's something we need you to see right now, Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, you gotta come over to SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?
